int_name: N BROAD ST & W GIRARD AVE

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with marked high-visibility crosswalks and a concrete refuge island. While pedestrian signals and sidewalks are present, the wide roadway and multiple travel lanes increase exposure time for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing their exposure to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry appears to allow for relatively high-speed vehicle turns.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles by extending the sidewalk into the parking lane area.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Install physical separation for cyclists, which also narrows the perceived roadway for drivers, encouraging slower speeds.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban intersection with integrated streetcar tracks and significant crossing distances. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the large expanse of asphalt and lack of high-visibility crossing markings or refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic and streetcar tracks without a median refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main intersection

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The lack of high-visibility paint at the intersection reduces driver awareness of the pedestrian crossing zone.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded rails can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slipping hazard for cyclists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with marked crosswalks and signalization, but significant pavement degradation and long crossing distances. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the large radius of the intersection and multiple travel lanes increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Large patches of crumbling asphalt and potholes in the middle of the intersection and crosswalk area create tripping hazards and may cause vehicles to swerve unpredictably.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and middle of the intersection

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the degraded roadway surface to eliminate tripping hazards and ensure predictable vehicle movements.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The environment features a multi-lane roadway with embedded streetcar tracks and significant commercial activity. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the crossing environment is compromised by long crossing distances, lack of high-visibility markings, and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles and street vendors.

hazards.name: Embedded Rail Tracks
hazards.description: Streetcar tracks embedded in the asphalt can cause tripping hazards for pedestrians and slipping hazards for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending into the distance

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Vendors
hazards.description: Street vendors and their structures on the right sidewalk may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of visible crosswalk markings at an intersection with a traffic signal increases the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines by moving pedestrians past parked vehicles/obstructions before they cross.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time remaining.
